t.en: Every crossing holds some gold coins: the number in each cell’s top-left corner. You may only go right or down, and you keep the coins at every crossing you pass through, start and end included.

goal.en: Going from the top left to the bottom right, how many coins can you collect at most?

how.en: Still row by row, from the top left.

body.en: It is the very same board as in <level-ref to="cheapest"></level-ref>, with the merger swapped to “max” and energy swapped for gold.

say.en: This time you want the most gold: use “max”.

hints.en: You walk one route only: at this crossing, which side would you pick?
The start has no way in, so the max gives “—”. At the start, feed a 0 into the merger.
